data.description:
## Summary
Standup report resolves worklog via `wl` cwd (git root). When launched from `~/.pi/agent/skills/standup` via `python3 $(skill_path standup)/scripts/generate_standup.py`, it resolves the global SA-* worklog (2033 items) instead of ContextHub WL-* (2203 items), producing incorrect yesterday/critical/additional counts.

## Problem
- `generate_standup.py` shells out to `wl next/list` with no `--worklog-dir`, so `wl` uses cwd git root.
- Yesterday: global has 15 in window vs ContextHub 1 (calendar 06:00 window). Global `-One last validation-` appears as the sole critical vs ContextHub's 2 (`WL-0MTMPIQBE001J41P`, `WL-0MTK1ILM2009QYB2`).
- Additional focus: global `others_limit = 20-(1+22)=0` → 0 additional vs ContextHub 3.
- Scheduled prompt passes worklogRoot but manual `python3 $(skill_path ...)` without cd triggers bug.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] `generate_standup.py` accepts `--worklog-dir <path>` (and `WL_WORKLOG_DIR` env) and forwards to all `wl` invocations so report is cwd-independent
- [ ] When launched from a non-owning cwd (e.g. `~/.pi/agent/skills/standup`) with `--worklog-dir /home/rgardler/projects/ContextHub/.worklog`, report matches ContextHub data (yesterday matches `wl --worklog-dir ... list`, criticals match Herdr head)
- [ ] Default without flag preserves current behaviour (cwd-derived worklog) for back-compat; no regression when run from ContextHub
- [ ] SKILL.md documents `--worklog-dir` flag
- [ ] Tests cover cwd-independent resolution

## Notes
Reproduced: `cd ~/.pi/agent/skills/standup && python3 scripts/generate_standup.py --json` → yesterday 15/critical 1 vs ContextHub → 1/2. Mirror audit_runner fix (SA-0MSLLGDW00098UCC) which redirects git to worklog-derived root when --worklog-dir is given.
data.title: Standup report is cwd-dependent: resolves wrong worklog when launched from skill dir
